_doc: The real rig, for code/real (arm_server.py, real_sim.py, real_box.py). World = the twin's frame (table top z = 0). Values from the twin (model/twin_6522.xml) unless noted; calib.json (written by calib_board.py / real_box.py check) overrides tool and cameras.

base_world._doc: the left arm's link0 in the twin (fit_robots.py)

tool._doc: adapter_dz: the real arm has an adapter between flange and hand that the twin lacks; MEASURE it (ruler: flange face to hand base) or let real_box.py check estimate it from the wrist depth, then put it in calib.json tool.adapter_dz

safety._joint_doc: the intersection of the Panda and FR3 limits (the deoxys config says platform fr3 in places: confirm which arm it is)
safety._v_doc: rad/s per joint, first runs (Panda allows 2.17-2.61; 10-28: 0.5/0.6 -> 0.3: the real arm trails its goals by 0.24-0.46 s x speed, different per joint, so faster moves leave the planned path more): the client stretches its moves to stay under it; the server refuses faster ones

keepout.name: the right arm (parked as in the twin)

safety._keepout_doc: boxes (world) that no point of the arm (joints, flange, hand corners, wrist camera) nor the TCP may enter; the right arm's parked hand is at (-0.494, -0.396, 0.531) in the twin (the program's own collision checks use its geometry; this box is the coarse second check)
safety._table_doc: the fingertips may go 4 mm under the nominal table plane: a pick aims 5 mm over the table as the wrist camera measures it (a few mm off with its calibration error); the arm is compliant

watchdog._doc: before every goal: a fault, after which the server sends nothing more and refuses everything until restarted, if no new robot state for stale_s (stale_engage_s in the first 3 s after taking control: deoxys switching controllers leaves ~0.9 s without state), the arm more than hold_max rad from the goal it holds between moves, a joint faster than dq_max rad/s, or a reflex / user stop. 10-28: franka-interface died as the server took control, auto_arm.sh restarted it, it drove the arm to the ready pose, and the server's old goal pulled joint 6 back at 4 rad/s, again every ~3 s

catch_up._doc: a move without settle (real_box run: all but the descents) ends once the arm is within tol rad of its last goal or has stopped, at most max_s after it (the arm trails ~lag_s x speed: the hold watchdog would see it > hold_max from the goal)

control._settle_doc: 10-30: max_s 3.0 -> 2.0 (197 real moves of 10-29: the joint error to the planned end 28 mrad median as the goals end, 8.3 at +1 s, 5.3 at +1.5, 3.7 at +2, 2.9 at +3; 26 of 173 settles reached tol)
control._doc: deoxys JOINT_IMPEDANCE (its default gains), goals at the NUC's POLICY_RATE 15 Hz, interpolated over the whole period; abort a move if a joint lags > track_abort + lag_factor x lag_s x its goal speed (lag_s: fitted 10-28 on the real arm, jog + touch: deoxys' impedance damps the joint speed with no feed-forward, so the arm trails by ~lag_s x speed) or the external force > force_abort N (the twin dry run: force_abort_twin: its arm is a stiff position servo, ~45 N to push the box, > 80 N when a finger lands on the hole block's edge; the real arm in joint impedance gives ~2.7 N per cm vertically at the touch pose); settle: after a free move, each time the arm has stopped (|dq| < still_dq for still_ticks goals) move the goal by gain x the remaining error (<= step_max per step, the total bias <= bias_max) until < tol or max_s (10-28: the earlier continuous integrator, ki 0.3 per goal, overshot on the real arm)

contact._set_down_doc: 10-29: real_box f_on sets the red tape down on the block by position, its bottom this far over the block's top as the wrist camera measured it (the guarded descent false-triggers on this arm: joint stiction)
contact._doc: guarded moves (touch, setting down; real): stop when the hand is held up 2 mm (has come down 2 mm less than a free arm following the same goals would: the server models it first-order with control.lag_s, since the real arm trails a 5 mm/s descent by ~2 mm; 4 mm more until the hand has come down 1 mm, as its joints take ~0.5 s to break their stiction) or the force estimate rises 4 N. 10-28: the earlier test, the hand 2 mm behind its command, stopped every real descent at its start

_speed_doc: real_sim's timing of a trajectory (10-30, real_box run; --old-timing: the 10-29 one, every move at speed stretched as a whole to v_max): each move on its own; the approaches and contacts (descend, lower into the box, set down, the lid, the push ...) at speed x the twin's (0.5 = half its speed), stretched to v_max if needed; the free moves (transits, up, lift, looks, retreats) at speed_free x the twin's, or where a joint would pass v_max, a trapezoid: at v_max, speeding up and slowing down at <= a_max rad/s2 per joint (10-29 real goals: 0.25 median, 0.8 p90 peak)

record._doc: real_box.py records every command but check (--no-record: off): both cameras' colour as MP4 at fps (H.264, crf), their depth if depth_fps > 0 (--record-depth N: lossless 16-bit mm, 0.1-0.5 MB/s per camera at 5 fps), each frame's time; the arm server logs the arm's state at state_hz all the time; real_box.py run then writes episode.mp4 (recorder.py compose)
